metaDescription: Forever Cabinets won London's 2026 Kitchen Remodeling award for White Shaker cabinetry. See the catalog, sample door program and delivery area.
summary: Forever Cabinets supplies plywood-box White Shaker kitchen cabinets to homeowners and contractors across Southern Ontario, with local freight delivery rather than a showroom visit. A refundable sample door program lets buyers check colour and build quality before ordering a full kitchen.

editorial.heading: What They Do
editorial.text: Forever Cabinets is a cabinet supplier rather than a full-service kitchen renovation contractor, offering a catalog of White Shaker base, wall, tall and specialty cabinets, including lazy Susans, microwave cabinets and angled corner units. The cabinets are plywood-box construction, a detail the company highlights as a durability marker over particleboard alternatives. Homeowners planning a kitchen remodel would typically pair this supplier with their own installer or general contractor.

editorial.heading: How They Work
editorial.text: Orders are placed from the catalog and delivered by local freight to London, Hamilton, Kitchener-Waterloo, Burlington and Oakville rather than picked up from a physical showroom. Before committing to a full cabinet order, customers can order a single refundable sample door to check the finish, colour match and build quality in their own kitchen lighting. This lower-commitment first step is the company's main point of trust-building with new customers.

editorial.heading: What to Expect
editorial.text: No customer reviews were available for this listing at the time of research. Homeowners should ask to see the sample door program in action and request photos of completed kitchens using the same cabinet line before placing a full order.

editorial.heading: Where They Work
editorial.text: Forever Cabinets delivers by local freight to London, Hamilton, Kitchener-Waterloo, Burlington and Oakville. Homeowners outside that delivery footprint should confirm freight availability before ordering.

What is the typical lead time from order to freight delivery?
Do you provide layout or measurement support, or is that the customer's responsibility?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means Forever Cabinets was selected as the top business in the Kitchen Remodeling category for London through an independent editorial review of public information and service scope. No business pays a fee to be selected.
The company's listed services describe cabinet supply, including a sample door program, rather than installation, so homeowners should plan for a separate installer or contractor.

faq.a: Customers can order a single refundable cabinet door before committing to a full kitchen order, letting them check colour, finish and build quality in their own home first.
